1. (Currently Amended) An apparatus, comprising: an __encoder (300) configured to encode mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the encoder (300) adapts the mode mapping information responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence by modifying the mapping based on said actual parameters before encoding__.
